description: The details of one event or activity: places left overall, and for each ticket type (tierId) its price, places left, any dates of its own and its deposit terms, plus its optional add-ons (for example bus transport or tent hire) with the price and how many are left. Also: whether it is in person, online or both (the online platform only, never the link), and for an activity its type, difficulty, duration, meeting point, what to bring, what each person booking must provide, whether a waiver is required, the minimum number of people, the cancellation policy, and a pre-registration link when the organiser has one. The tierId and add-on ids go into get_ticket_checkout_link.
name: check_event_availability
title: Check event availability
